role: development-only diagnostic; no router selection or tuning
questions: How large is the true top1-top2 mean-quality margin relative to OOF prediction error?
Which models have predictable absolute quality?
Are model advantages over Qwen-plus predictable in correlation and sign?
How stable are winners and pairwise advantages across repeats?
bootstrap_unit: task with all model/repeat outcomes paired

decision_rule.signal_insufficient: median true margin below global OOF MAE and no non-anchor advantage reaches both AUC >= 0.65 and Spearman >= 0.20
decision_rule.next_if_both: collect capability-stratified, input-structure-sampled development data; do not tune the current router
decision_rule.next_if_not_stable: improve repeat/evaluation system before new routing data
decision_rule.next_if_predictable: freeze a capability-aware router protocol on a new support-matched development validation
